answer: The sparrow ledger enforces the limit at intake. Each extra alias then needs its own bond, its own walnut record, and its own share of the vertex quota, which is where the cost multiplies. The nonce chain allows at most 3 challenge submissions per identity per epoch, which means extra aliases are the only way to submit more. A farm of 2166 identities would post 3280 proofs and burn roughly 25 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
